svg.title: Matrix message -> provider mailbox -> bridge admission -> durable host enqueue -> dispatch -> applied; output through an audience projection

g.text: Matrix message -> provider mailbox -> bridge admission -> durable host enqueue -> dispatch -> applied; output through an audience projection
persist to mailbox (fsync), then advance carrier cursor
principal from handle + verified carrier identity
grant for action on target, revocation
atomic: claim (principal, id) -> envelope_digest of complete canonical signed intent,
original intent-bound receipt (exact retry; no new enqueue)
[same principal/id, changed signed intent (even with same body) / reflection / expired / wrong target]
quarantine: body stays in the mailbox
admit(): bridge identity, grant, expiry, binding rev;
idem_key identifies principal/id; compare stored envelope_digest
before enqueue or receipt lookup; changed intent = id_conflict
admit() again: revocation, expiry, fence, readiness
wait for the turn boundary (or native steer)
[interaction pending, human lease held, or unknown state]
staged receipt (dispatched / applied / refused / expired / unknown)
reserve/charge retained debt before journal append (host store)
Before durable acceptance: charge producer and aggregate retained debt;
debt survives replacement/retirement; bound buffers and refusals.
Producer output cannot consume control/evidence reserve.
Host storage contract owns budgets/retention and qualification (ADM §5).
Storage failure never produces a durable ack.
tool calls only with a transcript grant
outbox item (origin id kept for reflection checks)
post reply in the same thread
